admission_blockers: Physical observation chain and effective sample size unqualified.
Fresh target-compilation identity and applied-control availability unverified.
Current seconds/credits/shot ceilings and reserve not priced or approved.
Target-only versus paired payload form remains a stated confound.
Independent user approval of a fully written executable case is absent.

planning_sensitivity_only.bound: Union bound over all 2^24 subsets and 18 empirical laws: epsilon=sqrt((24 ln 2 + ln(18/alpha))/(2n)).
planning_sensitivity_only.qualification: Conditional planning calculation only. Independence, physical trials, processing and effective n remain unqualified.

scope: Distinguishes predecessor dependence from target invariance; cannot distinguish stale controls from result association without provider-side evidence.
static_control_boundary: Target-only means no preceding iteration in that invocation, not a reset of provider history; its payload-form difference is a control limitation.
status: draft; not admitted; no submission authorization
stop_rules: Stop on any target parameter/seed/returned-compilation change, incomplete result, unknown effective policy or invalid control.
Support history dependence only when a simultaneous lower bound on a counterbalanced target difference exceeds 0.1 and predecessors themselves respond distinctly.
Support a stable setting-specific wrong response only when simultaneous upper bounds are below 0.1 across distinct predecessors and the wrong-target response persists.
Otherwise close inconclusive within the written budget; never retry automatically.
